name: Majakkahotelli
niche_feature: All 15 hotel rooms are in the Kylmapihlaja lighthouse tower on an outer-sea island; the island also has eight separate two-person cottages, which are not in the tower.
evidence_quote: Kaikki majoitushuoneemme sijaitsevat majakan tornissa ja niistä on merimaisema, pois lukien economy huone, josta näkymä on majakan terassille.
reason: Official page states all hotel rooms are in the lighthouse tower; cottages are extra units.

name: Norah Head Lighthouse & Cottages
niche_feature: Both bookable units are the Head and Assistant Lighthouse Keepers' Quarters (3 bedrooms, 9 guests each) beside the 1903 tower on the lighthouse reserve; guests do not sleep in the tower.
evidence_quote: the quaint Lighthouse Keeper’s Quarters and Assistant Lighthouse Keeper’s Quarters remain available for holiday bookings
reason: Keepers' quarters on a lighthouse station qualify; both units are the quarters.

name: Phare de Kerbel
niche_feature: Studio in place of the lantern room 25 m up the tower, plus a former oil room outbuilding and the attached keeper's house, all on the lighthouse property.
evidence_quote: le Phare de Kerbel est le seul phare de France habitable en son sommet
reason: Official site shows a studio in the tower plus outbuilding and keeper's house on the station.

name: Quirpon Lighthouse Inn
niche_feature: Ten rooms in a restored 1922 light-keeper's home at the base of a still-operating lighthouse on Quirpon Island; guests do not sleep in the tower. Page fetched via tool because direct curl returned 403.
evidence_quote: Quirpon Lighthouse Inn features ten beautiful rooms at the base of a still-operating lighthouse
reason: Rooms are in the keeper's home on a working lighthouse station; seasonal status not stated.
page_issues: Booking widget on official page references 2021 dates, so current season/opening not confirmed
Iceberg Alley and 'quintessential lighthouse life' wording not checked against the page

name: Saugerties Lighthouse
niche_feature: Two second-floor double bedrooms inside the 1869 lighthouse (rented together, shared bathroom with composting toilet), on a river shoal reached by half-mile trail; the tower is open to guests.
evidence_quote: There are two second-floor bedrooms, each with a double bed.
reason: Guests sleep inside the lighthouse building; official B&B open Thursday to Sunday nights year-round.

name: Sitka Lighthouse
niche_feature: The whole lighthouse (built 1983 as Rockwell Lighthouse; two bedrooms, 1.5 baths) is rented as a private-island vacation rental; guests sleep inside it. Water taxi included, five-minute boat ride.
evidence_quote: Inside the historic lighthouse, a glass-walled room offers panoramic views of Alaskan beauty shifting with the tide throughout the day.
reason: Official site confirms guests stay inside the lighthouse on Rockwell Island.

name: STF Berguddens Fyrvaktarbostäder
niche_feature: Five rooms (11-25 beds) in the former lighthouse keepers' dwellings beside Bergudden lighthouse on Holmön; shared self-catering kitchen, no running water, outhouse toilet. Not in the tower.
evidence_quote: Här har fyrvaktare med familjer bott och verkat genom historien.
reason: Keepers' dwellings on a lighthouse station qualify; official STF page lists five rooms.

name: Vuurtoren van Harlingen
niche_feature: The whole lighthouse tower is one accommodation unit for two over three floors, with the bed on the middle level; run by Dromen aan Zee. Dedicated site vuurtoren-harlingen.nl had an expired TLS certificate and was not read.
evidence_quote: De Vuurtoren van Harlingen is uniek in Europa: nergens anders kun je in de top van een vuurtoren overnachten.
reason: Operator page confirms overnight stays in the lighthouse tower itself.
page_issues: Dedicated site vuurtoren-harlingen.nl has an expired SSL certificate (could not be read safely)

name: andBeyond Benguerra Island
niche_feature: Official page lists 13 beach units (2 Cabanas, 10 Casinhas, 1 Casa Familia) among forest and white sand with beach-facing plunge pools; nothing states they are over water or on stilts.
evidence_quote: Thirteen spacious rooms are tucked between indigenous forest and soft white sand
reason: Beachfront island lodge, not overwater; fits no category well. Closest is safari-lodges (andBeyond lodge in a marine park), a weak fit.
page_issues: Page says fourteen casitas and villas; official lists 13 rooms (10 Casinhas, 2 Cabanas, 1 Casa Familia)
Not overwater: units are beachfront, so the overwater-bungalows category does not apply
Unsupported superlatives (largest dugong population in Western Indian Ocean, world-class snorkelling)

name: Bora Bora Nui Resort & Spa
niche_feature: Resort (now Conrad Bora Bora Nui, 114 villas per Forbes Travel Guide) is mostly overwater bungalows, with some beachfront, garden and hillside villas. Hilton official site returned 403.
evidence_quote: The majority of the resort consists of overwater bungalows
reason: Majority overwater bungalows per Forbes Travel Guide; official Hilton page blocked; reopened May 2026 after renovation.
page_issues: Resort now operates as Conrad Bora Bora Nui; page uses old name
Closed for renovation early 2026 per press, reopened 1 May 2026
Not every villa is overwater (beach, garden and hillside villas exist)
Unsupported claims: 'format was invented here', views of Otemanu from every deck, 'among the best' snorkelling

name: Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Landaa Giraavaru
niche_feature: Official fact sheet lists 103 villas including Water villas and Beach villas; fourseasons.com accommodation pages returned 403 and Forbes Travel Guide describes overwater villas alongside beach villas. Overwater count not given.
evidence_quote: Water villas have mezzanine-level lofts accessed by spiral staircase for ocean views
reason: Water villas confirmed by Four Seasons fact sheet and Forbes; only part of the 103 villas are overwater.
page_issues: Not all 103 villas are overwater; beach villas exist
Superlatives: world's largest known manta aggregations
Plunge pool and glass floor panels in each villa not confirmed

name: Gili Lankanfushi
niche_feature: 45 villas and residences described as overwater villas, including the Private Reserve and Crusoe Residences reached by short boat ride; villa pages describe overwater sundecks.
evidence_quote: authentically-styled yet luxuriously appointed overwater villas with pools in Maldives
reason: Official site presents all 45 villas and residences as overwater.
page_issues: Private Reserve is 1,700 sqm on the official page, not 1,600 sqm
'World's largest overwater villa' is the resort's own claim ('largest stand-alone overwater villa')
'Twenty minutes by speedboat' and sustainability-ranking claims not confirmed
